text:
anya: Quick intake — new model 'havoc-15b'. Owner: @sam. 
Short summary: 15B decoder, trained on mixed web/code/filtered-cc, permissive license. Asking for: quant experiments (nf4/int8), quality baseline vs current catalog defaults, catalog writeup, and announcement plan. Recommend medium-high priority (hosted + dedicated validation). Can we get an initial perf+quality snapshot by EOD Fri? :rocket:

sam: Ack, I can take ownership. Will spin a staging run today. What perf/cost targets should we use as baseline?

lee: Quick numbers from initial unoptimized run on g5.12xlarge (staging):
- unbatched throughput: ~8 tok/s
- batched (batch=8): ~80 tok/s
- GPU mem: ~26GB
I'll try nf4 quant next. Command I'm using:
```
python tools/quantize.py --model-dir /mnt/models/havoc-15b --out-dir /var/models/havoc-15b-nf4 --quant nf4 --group 128
```

marta: Draft catalog snippet (for docs PR):
Model: havoc-15b
Family: Havoc
License: MIT-like
Recommended profiles: hosted-default, dedicated-performance
Quantized variants planned: nf4, int8
Known gaps: -3.2% on AKO-commonsense benchmark vs lumen-13b, slightly higher hallucination rate on KBExact.

olivier: Timeline suggestion: validation + quant perf by Fri, docs PR + model-card by next Mon, announce in #product + a short blog the following week. I can coordinate announcement. Proposed GA date: 2026-04-01 subject to perf/quality gates. :calendar:

devops-bot: CI: model build job `model-build/havoc-15b` started
devops-bot: CI: `model-build/havoc-15b` completed — artifacts: s3://redwood-models/havoc-15b/ (size 28.3GB)

sam: Eval plan -> prioritize: MMLU, HellaSwag, Winogrande, AKO-commonsense, KBExact, Safety prompts. Run with same prompts as lumen-13b baseline. Eval cmd:
`python evals/run_eval.py --model havoc-15b --bench mmlu,hellaswag,winogrande,ako,kbexact --out /tmp/havoc-eval.json`

lee: NF4 results (staging, converted):
- batched (8): 125 tok/s (+56%)
- memory: 17.5GB
- MMLU delta vs lumen-13b: -1.1 pts
Notes: nf4 looks promising for cost/throughput; check failure modes on KBExact and open-domain QA.

marta: I'll open the docs PR with the catalog entry + short model-card today. Will include recommended rollout flags (cache TTL=30s, batch target=6, fallback to lumen-13b for seq>512)

anya: Action items:
- sam: full eval suite + cost calc (due Fri)
- lee: run int8 experiment + additional decode quality checks (due Fri)
- marta: PR for catalog and model card (due Mon)
- olivier: announcement plan & capacity commit check (due Mon)

sam: Noted. I'll post results in this thread. Thanks all. :eyes:
